arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Phillips argued the distinction between discrimination outside and inside the seniority system.
Ms. Blatt argued the Ninth Circuit decision imposes retroactive liability on AT&T.
Justice Breyer questioned the distinction between maintaining a salary structure and administering it unlawfully.
Justice Souter asked why the same analysis cannot apply to daily retirement benefits.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: AT&T seeks to keep its pension plan unchanged. Hulteen wants the court to strike down the plan. The dispute centers on how the plan credits time off for pregnancy versus other illnesses.
